title: tara tinctoria var. horrida
intro: Tara tinctoria var. horrida, commonly known as the 'horrida' or ' rough' tara, is a variety of the Tara tree, native to South America, particularly in the Andean regions. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relieving anxiety and stress, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality. The health benefits of Tara tinctoria var. horrida include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties.
